mapper.select: SELECT crd02_approval_no AS approval_no , crd02_approval_dt::date AS approval_dt , crd02_approval_amount AS approval_amount , COALESCE(biz01_tax, 0) AS tax FROM biz01_promo INNER JOIN crd02_data ON crd02_data_id = biz01_card_data_id WHERE biz01_company_id = #{companyId} AND biz01_promo_id = #{promoId}

SELECT ast06_tr_id AS tr_id , ast06_date AS date , ast06_tr_cd AS tr_code , f_cdnm('trCode', ast06_tr_cd, ast06_company_id, ast06_date) AS tr_name , ast06_corp_id AS corp_id , f_get_corp_nm(ast06_corp_id) AS corp_name , ast06_ast_class_tree_id AS ast_class_tree_id , f_ast_class_tree_nm_allpath(ast06_ast_class_tree_id) AS class_tree_full_name , ast06_note AS note , ast06_card_approval_no AS card_approval_no FROM ast06_tr WHERE ast06_company_id = #{companyId} AND ast06_card_approval_no = #{cardApprovalNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ast06_tr (ast06_tr_id, ast06_company_id, ast06_person_id, ast06_date, ast06_amt, ast06_tax, ast06_cont_amt, ast06_settle_mng_yn, ast06_cur_cd, ast06_fx_rate, ast06_for_amt, ast06_for_cont_amt, ast06_card_approval_no, ast06_pur_tr_id, ast06_tr_cd, ast06_corp_id, ast06_ast_class_tree_id, ast06_note) VALUES (#{trId}, #{companyId}, #{personId}, #{date}, #{amt}, #{tax}, #{contAmt}, 'true', 'KRW', 1, #{amt}, #{contAmt}, #{cardApprovalNo}, #{trId}, #{trCd}, #{corpId}, #{astClassTreeId}, #{note})
